mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Leytonstone E11 to Heathrow Airport?

mainEntity.name: How far is Leytonstone E11 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leytonstone E11 is approximately 18 miles (29 km) from Heathrow Airport via the A12 westbound linking to the A406 North Circular and then the A40 towards Heathrow. Journey times typically range from 45 to 70 minutes depending on traffic conditions through east and inner London and along the A40 Heathrow corridor.
